name: GIS Tools
description: EPSG projection, layer merge, DXF/CSV/GeoPackage/SHP/KML export, save to original file, basemap loader, containment check, donut fix.
author: Arun Prashad

commands.label:
Set
Projection
commands.help: Assign an EPSG projection to all selected layers (or the active layer). Run with {"epsg": 27700} — e.g. 4326 WGS84, 27700 British National Grid, 28992 Dutch RD, 3857 Web Mercator.
commands.params: {"epsg": "EPSG code number or EPSG:XXXX string", "layer"?: "layer name or id"}

commands.label:
Load
Basemap
commands.help: Add a web tile basemap. Run with {"basemap": "<key>"} where key is one of: google_satellite_cn, google_satellite, google_terrain, google_roads, google_hybrid, bing_aerial, bing_maps, osm, open_topo, esri_world_imagery.
commands.params: {"basemap": "basemap key — google_satellite | google_terrain | osm | esri_world_imagery | bing_aerial | …"}

commands.label:
Merge All
Layers
commands.help: Merge all loaded vector layers into one. Each feature gains a 'source_layer' attribute with the source layer name.

commands.label:
Export
DXF
commands.help: Export selected (or all) vector layers to a DXF file. Run with {"epsg": 27700} to set the output projection. A save dialog will appear.
commands.params: {"epsg"?: "EPSG code for output coordinates", "path"?: "output .dxf file path", "label_field"?: "attribute to use as label"}

commands.label:
Export
Layer
commands.help: Export the active layer to a new file. A save dialog lets you choose the format by extension: .gpkg (GeoPackage), .shp (Shapefile), .geojson, .kml, .kmz. Coordinates are saved as WGS84.
commands.params: {"layer"?: "layer name or id (default: active/selected)", "path"?: "output file path"}

commands.label:
Save to
Original
commands.help: Save the active layer back to its original file, retaining the original format. A save dialog opens pre-filled with the original filename — confirm or navigate to the file to overwrite.
commands.params: {"layer"?: "layer name or id (default: active/selected)", "path"?: "file path to overwrite"}

commands.label:
Export
Table
commands.help: Export the active layer's attribute table to a CSV file (opens in Excel). A save dialog will appear.
commands.params: {"layer"?: "layer name or id (default: active/selected)", "path"?: "output .csv file path"}

commands.label:
Check
Containment
commands.help: Find polygons fully inside other polygons in the active layer. Creates a new layer with area_m2, net_area_m2, contained_in and contains_count attributes.

commands.label:
Fix
Donuts
commands.help: Convert inner polygons to holes in their outer polygon. Creates a new layer with correct donut geometries so area measurements are accurate.

commands.label:
Next
Feature
commands.help: Zoom to the next feature in the active layer. Cycles through all features one by one.

commands.label:
Prev
Feature
commands.help: Zoom to the previous feature in the active layer.

commands.label:
Debug
Select API
commands.help: Test all known selection API calls and log results. Run once to find the working API — check RustGIS console/log for results.

panel.title: GIS Tools
panel.help: Run commands from the buttons below. For Set Projection and Load Basemap, use the Tools pane to supply the EPSG code or basemap key.
